The initiation of anticoagulation (AK) treatment for patients with atrial fibrillation is a critical measure of cardiovascular care. This comparison analyzes the timing of treatment initiation across [[danmark|Danmark]] and its five regions, specifically examining whether patients started treatment within four months prior to their diagnosis or within 30 days after hospital discharge [^src1]. 

Nationally, out of 11,432 patients, the majority (55.6%) began their anticoagulation treatment within the four months leading up to their diagnosis, while the remaining 44.4% started within 30 days post-discharge [^src1]. When evaluating regional performance, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] leads in early treatment initiation prior to diagnosis, with 56.9% of its 2,635 patients starting treatment in this window [^src1]. Conversely, [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] records the lowest proportion for pre-diagnosis treatment at 54.7% [^src1]. 

The inverse pattern emerges for treatment initiated after discharge. [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] leads this metric, with 45.3% of its patients starting treatment within 30 days post-discharge [^src1]. [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] trails in this category, with 43.1% of patients starting treatment after discharge [^src1]. The other regions—[[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]]—cluster closely around the national averages, showing minimal deviation in either timeframe [^src1]. Because the available data consists of a single snapshot, no temporal trends or longitudinal improvements can be assessed, and the table does not specify any explicit clinical targets or thresholds to determine if these regional rates meet national standards [^src1].

| Nordjylland | 697 55.2 | 565 44.8 | 1262 |

Entities: danmark, region-hovedstaden, region-sjaelland, region-syddanmark, region-midtjylland, region-nordjylland

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner andelen af atrieflimren-patienter, der starter antikoagulationsbehandling enten inden for 4 måneder før diagnose eller inden for 30 dage efter udskrivelse, på nationalt og regionalt niveau.
